csv_project_name: SMF Facilities Condition Assessment & Asset Mgt
csv_scope_of_work: The County of Sacramento (County) owns and/or operates four airports in Sacramento County, including Sacramento International Airport (SMF or Airport), Mather Airport (MHR), Sacramento Executive Airport (SAC), and Franklin Field (F72) through the Department of Airports (SCDA or Department). SCDA is issuing this Request for Proposals (RFP) to solicit proposals from qualified firms to provide comprehensive Airport Facilities Condition Assessment (FCA) and Asset Management Services across its airport system. SCDA is seeking professional services to perform an Airport Facilities Condition Assessment (FCA) and provide related Asset Management Services across its airport system.
csv_disciplines_requested: Architecture Services, Civil Engineering, Inspection Services, Planning/Master Planning, Electrical Engineering, Structural Engineering
csv_comments: '- Project Number: 2026WW03- Pre-Submittal Notes: Please e-mail William Wallace at wallacew@saccounty.gov to attend the Pre-Proposal Conference. Attendance requests will be accepted for the Mandatory Virtual Pre-Proposal Conference until 12:00 PM on Monday, July 27, 2026. Your e-mail should include your company’s name and the names, phone numbers, and e-mail addresses of those who will be attending the conference. Only two (2) representatives from any (1) prospective Proposer will be allowed.- Pre-Submittal Meeting: 07/28/2026 10:00 AM PDT- Pre-Submittal Location: Virtual Pre-Proposal- Pre-Submittal Attendance: Mandatory- Solicitation documents available online.- Questions Deadline: Submit questions online by 08/04/2026 12:00 PM PDT Mandatory pre-bid meeting July 28 at 10:00 AM PDT
title: SMF Facilities Condition Assessment & Asset Management
short_description: Airport-wide facilities condition assessment and asset management services for Sacramento County airports.
project_scope: Professional services for a comprehensive facilities condition assessment and related asset management across four Sacramento County airports: Sacramento International Airport (SMF), Mather Airport (MHR), Sacramento Executive Airport (SAC), and Franklin Field (F72). The scope covers airport facilities system-wide; no specific building sizes, spans, or construction quantities are stated.
services: Facilities condition assessment, asset management services, architecture, civil engineering, inspection services, planning/master planning, electrical engineering, and structural engineering.
relevance_explanation:
- Primarily a facilities condition assessment and asset management assignment, not a structural design project.
- Includes structural engineering among requested disciplines, but no defined bridge, roof, long-span, or special structure scope.
- Strongly oriented toward assessment, inspection, and planning/asset management, which is generally low priority for sbp.
- Airport context could involve varied structures, but the notice provides no technically demanding structural component.
construction_cost_explanation: No construction budget is stated. This is a professional services procurement for assessment and asset management across four airports, not a defined construction project. No realistic construction cost estimate can be derived from the notice alone.
fee_explanation: No fee information is stated. The notice only identifies a professional services RFP for airport-wide facilities condition assessment and asset management; without scope quantities, asset counts, or contract term details, a realistic sbp fee estimate is not possible.
references_qualifications: Qualified firms to provide comprehensive airport facilities condition assessment and asset management services; requested disciplines include architecture, civil engineering, inspection services, planning/master planning, electrical engineering, and structural engineering. No specific minimum reference counts or detailed qualification thresholds are stated in the notice excerpt.
contracting_authority: County of Sacramento, Department of Airports, Sacramento County, California, USA. Contact: William Wallace. Phone: 916-874-0771. Email: wallacew@saccounty.gov. Website: https://procurement.opengov.com/portal/saccounty/projects/281692
notes: Project number: 2026WW03. Mandatory virtual pre-proposal conference on 07/28/2026 at 10:00 AM PDT; attendance requests due by 07/27/2026 12:00 PM. Questions deadline: 08/04/2026 12:00 PM PDT.
